findings.text: src/blueprint/apply.js:271-316 applyBlueprint replaces an owned user story from a new blueprint version verbatim, so a version can lighten an existing criterion (absent or full to journey or external, journey to external) with no reason and no decision in rcf/define/decisions-ledger.json; ruling 40 named define update only, so the gap is in the spec (P1-2 from the Codex re-review, class spec by ruling 46 of the stage-keeper); the test-author adds criteria refusing that replacement (exit 2, naming the criterion and both levels) unless --reason <text> is given, which writes the same resolved decision, a first application at any level staying direct (ruling 49)

src/build/verdict.js:155 and src/finalise/light.js:201 neither rcf build verdict review nor light Finalise checks that every criterion lighter at head than at base has a resolved decision in rcf/define/decisions-ledger.json naming that criterion and both levels, so any write path (blueprint apply, a hand edit to a story JSON, a future writer) can lighten a criterion past the gate (ruling 48 of the stage-keeper, class spec); the test-author adds criteria making both refuse and name each such criterion, pass when every lightening has its decision, and stay silent for creations and tightenings
